tariffInterpretation: Conservative standard API USD-equivalent exposure, not an account billing statement. Existing coding-plan quota charges may differ.
outputBoundInterpretation: Official max_tokens limits all generated tokens; reasoning is generated content and consumes the same output allowance. Inclusive provider usage is validated on every response; missing/inconsistent usage retains full exposure.
inputBoundInterpretation: One token per UTF8 byte of complete request messages plus 1024 framing tokens; conservative bound relative to published no-tool chat template.
outputCapRationale: The 30 pilot requests with known usage used at most281 output tokens under the inclusive tariff calculation. A1024-token request cap retains more than3.6x that observed maximum and the official recommended minimum, reducing unnecessary worst-case reservations in the corrected preregistration. Length failures remain failures.
